executionPolicy.firstMode: sandbox or shadow/reconciliation mode; licensed provider remains authoritative
executionPolicy.timeoutState: UNKNOWN until verified through authoritative provider status/settlement evidence
executionPolicy.sourceArtifactLimitation: Source inspection, static gates, unit tests, fixtures, mocked providers and a passing contract harness do not establish live operational or external approval.
executionPolicy.moneyMovement: Keep production money movement disabled until provider, institution, security, legal/privacy and release approvals are independently evidenced.
executionPolicy.releaseRule: A release must stop at the lowest incomplete evidence-ladder level. No status can be promoted by generating or editing a report alone.

gates.title: Supported runtime and clean install
minimumEvidence: Node.js >=24.15.0 and npm >=11.0.0 are observed in the same clean run.
.nvmrc and all root/backend/frontend package engines agree.
Fresh npm ci --include=dev passes from each tracked lockfile on the documented OS.
Root checks, backend tests, frontend tests and production builds pass; command logs and artifact hashes are retained.
gates.releaseRule: No passing supported-runtime CI = no promotion.

gates.title: Bootstrap, lifecycle, health and readiness
minimumEvidence: Start and stop the application twice in one test run; assert one canonical Express application instance.
Inject failure at each bootstrap phase; assert reverse-order rollback and clean dependency disconnect.
/api/v1/health and /api/v1/ready report the documented state with real MongoDB and Redis dependencies.
Readiness returns non-ready/503 while required dependencies are unavailable and recovers after restoration.
No source-only substitute, fake health state or swallowed startup exception.
gates.releaseRule: Unproven bootstrap lifecycle or dependency readiness blocks promotion.

gates.title: Ledger invariants, transaction atomicity and replay safety
minimumEvidence: MongoDB transaction-capable replica set proves commit, abort and rollback.
Durable unique constraints protect financial operation, provider event/callback and idempotency scopes; Redis is not the sole financial uniqueness authority.
Concurrent same-key/same-payload and same-key/conflicting-payload tests produce at most one financial effect.
Repeat the duplicate/replay tests after backend restart and Redis restart; retain before/after persisted records.
Every posted journal balances by currency; amounts use exact decimal/minor-unit arithmetic; reversals are compensating history.
Balance reconstruction equals ledger replay; all unexplained invariant mismatches equal zero.
gates.releaseRule: Zero unexplained invariant failure; any duplicate financial effect or unbalanced journal blocks promotion.

gates.title: Provider outcome, retry, refund, reversal and settlement
minimumEvidence: Authenticated provider request and documented idempotency/reference mapping.
Signed callback authentication plus duplicate and out-of-order callback tests.
Timeout or lost response enters UNKNOWN; query provider status before retrying or issuing any second debit.
Bounded retry/backoff, provider outage, delayed callback and recovery tests preserve one effect.
Refund/reversal tests create compensating ledger events and audit evidence without rewriting posted history.
Authoritative provider settlement evidence matches TITech operation, currency, amount, ledger and receipt.
gates.releaseRule: Never infer DECLINED/FAILED from a timeout. No live money-moving workflow without provider/institution/legal authorization.

gates.title: Tenant isolation and permission enforcement
minimumEvidence: Live API/E2E negative tests cover cross-tenant read, write, list/search, aggregate/report, export, document and audit access.
Tenant scope is derived and enforced server-side; client-supplied tenant identifiers are not authorization.
Least privilege is tested for member, operator, approver, auditor and service-to-service identities.
Maker-checker separation is enforced server-side and tested against self-approval and privilege escalation.
Denied and privileged actions produce privacy-safe, tamper-evident audit evidence.
gates.releaseRule: Any cross-tenant leakage, broken separation of duties or unexplained permission bypass blocks promotion.

gates.title: Security assessment, document safety and recovery
minimumEvidence: Independent application security assessment completed; findings severity-ranked, assigned, fixed or formally risk-accepted.
Dependency, secret, container/image and infrastructure-as-code scans run against the release candidate.
Private-document scanner has live clean and EICAR test-signature proof, fail-closed evidence, alerting and upload-path E2E.
Encrypted backup restore validates account/journal/transaction counts and balance reconstruction.
Rollback drill and incident-response tabletop are executed; recovery time/data loss and owners recorded.
gates.releaseRule: Untriaged critical/high findings or missing restore/rollback proof block promotion.

gates.title: Uganda legal/privacy, regulatory boundary and partner authority
minimumEvidence: Qualified Uganda counsel documents the activity-by-activity regulatory boundary and conditions; no assumption of deposit-taking/lending authority.
PDPO registration/status and controller/processor obligations are confirmed from authoritative records and counsel.
Institution and provider authority is documented in signed agreements/authorization, with sandbox scope and liability boundaries.
Restricted financial-product capabilities are server-side feature-flagged OFF until approved; approvals are versioned and time-bound.
Privacy notices, lawful basis/consent, retention, data-subject requests, DPIA where applicable, breach handling and cross-border transfers are reviewed.
gates.releaseRule: No unapproved regulated activity and no money movement beyond the authorized sandbox/shadow scope.

gates.title: Real institutional pilot and commercial conversion
minimumEvidence: Named institution, accountable sponsor, operational owner and approved real workflow are evidenced.
Signed pilot terms, scope, data-processing roles, success criteria and escalation contacts exist.
Baseline is recorded before rollout; weekly review measures reconciliation time, exception rate, failure recovery, user adoption and cost.
Measured ROI is signed off by the institution and source data is retained.
Paid conversion/invoice evidence and renewal or paid continuation are captured; an MOU/conversation alone is not proof.
gates.releaseRule: No commercial scale claim without a measured pilot and paid institutional evidence.
